question: The loss of MHC class I makes the cells susceptible to lysis by:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Loss of MHC class I -> decreased recognition by Tc lymphocytes -> increased susceptibility to lysis by Tc lymphocytes -> 95% CHAIN: Loss of MHC class I -> increased susceptibility to lysis by NK lymphocytes -> 90% CHAIN: Loss of MHC class I -> reduced antigen presentation to Tc lymphocytes -> decreased Tc lymphocyte activation -> 95%
analysis: The loss of MHC class I molecules on cells makes them susceptible to lysis by NK lymphocytes, as these cells can recognize and kill cells lacking MHC class I molecules.
